result.summary: Found 4 visual issues: incorrect bottom navigation active state, inconsistent favorite icon styling, truncated restaurant name at carousel edge, and a cut-off empty category chip.

issues.description: Bottom tab bar highlights Profile in green as active while the screen shows the Home feed content
issues.suggestion: Set Home tab to active state (green) and Profile to inactive (gray) when on the home feed

issues.description: Favorite heart icon on Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has no circular background/scrim while the pizza card below shows heart inside a dark circle
issues.suggestion: Apply consistent heart button style with dark circular background and scrim on all Popular cards

issues.description: Third card in Fastest near you shows restaurant name truncated as 'Trattoria Piccol' at screen edge without ellipsis
issues.suggestion: Ensure carousel cards have proper padding and truncated titles use ellipsis

issues.description: Far right edge of category filter row shows a partially visible empty pill with no label
issues.suggestion: Fix horizontal scroll padding so chips are not cut to an empty sliver or ensure all chips render labels
